question:
In Scotland Premier League, which away team won the most during the 2010 season?
Benchmark knowledge evidence: Final result should return the Team.team_long_name; Scotland Premier League refers to League.name = 'Scotland Premier League'; away team refers to away_team_api_id; away team that won the most refers to MAX(SUBTRACT(away_team_goal, home_team_goal) > 0); 2010 season refers to season = '2009/2010'; won the most refers to MAX(COUNT(*));

prediction.sql:
SELECT t.XCL_173
FROM Match m
JOIN League l ON m.XCL_008 = l.XCL_003
JOIN Team t ON m.XCL_014 = t.XCL_171
WHERE l.XCL_005 = 'Scotland Premier League'
  AND m.XCL_009 = '2009/2010'
  AND m.XCL_016 > m.XCL_015
GROUP BY t.XCL_171
ORDER BY COUNT(*) DESC
LIMIT 1;
